text:
Nina: FYI ACME wants a polymorphic canary for their private deployment: tenant-scoped flags + per-region weighting + deterministic fallback mapping. Kickoff tomorrow.
Harper: Can we surface this as a single feature-flag resource (namespace + variants) or do we need separate flags per region?
Devon: Prefer single resource with region slices in metadata. Simpler for UI and infra. Example: tenant namespace, variants: shadow/opt_in/ramp, region_weights map.
Leila: Important constraints: 1) KMS integration (HSM wrap) for tenant keys, 2) fallback must be explicit (quantized-variant OR cached-response), 3) telemetry contract + quality checks before >10% ramp.
Nina: Agreed. Also ACME asked for an A/B hook so they can run small AB tests during opt_in stage. Need to include sampling and evaluation windows.
Harper: Draft rollout phases i'm proposing: (a) dark shadow (0% routing, full shadow logs) 48h, (b) tenant opt-in 1% -> 5% for 3d, (c) gated ramp 10% -> 50% over 2w, (d) full. Kill-switch per stage and per-region.
Devon: Auto-fallback rules: if P95 latency > 450ms for 5m OR model_error_rate > 0.8% -> route to `fallback_variant`. If region capacity < 10% free -> spill to next region according to geo-affinity. For Private installs, spill = quantized local variant or cached-prefix.
Leila: We must ship a telemetry contract to ACME with required metrics: p50,p95,p99 latency, success_rate, token_cost, quality_delta_on_eval_set. They want daily digest + webhook for threshold alerts.
Nina: Also include audit trail for flag changes (who, when, before/after config) and a migration path to tenant-managed flags if they want later.
flag-bot: Generated starter flag document (edit as needed):
```
flag_id: acme.polymorphic_canary.v1
tenant: acme-corp
variants: [shadow, opt_in, ramp, off]
region_weights: { eu: {variant: shadow, percent: 0}, us: {variant: opt_in, percent: 1}, apac: {variant: shadow, percent: 0} }
ab_tests: [{id: ab1, sample: 0.5, eval_window_minutes: 60}]
fallback_policy: quantized_local_variant -> cached_prefix -> 520_response
canary_windows_minutes: 60
kill_switch_ids: [ks-acme-polymorph-v1, ks-acme-region-us-v1]
telemetry_webhook: https://hooks.example.com/acme-rollout
```
Harper: Need a small runbook section in the PR: how to trigger kill switch, how to revert flag, how to validate eval metrics. Add example commands and quick queries.
Devon: Action items: I will prototype region_weights schema + infra checks by Wed. Leila to draft telemetry contract and AB evaluation queries. Harper to mock flag UI and kill-switch surface. Nina to confirm ACME CSM timeline and legal SLOs.
Leila: Add security gate: KMS proof-of-integration + threat model sign-off before any routing. If fail -> keep flag `shadow` until remediation.
Nina: Great. I'll schedule the 30m kickoff and share notes. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
